titles.title: Pink Petunias in a White Glass

description: Three pink petunias with bright yellow centers sit in a white vase. Two flowers face the viewer, while the third is only partially visible behind them. The vase rests on a white surface which also forms the background of the composition.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
